REAL_BUG_FOUND_AND_FIXED_FALSE_BLOCKER.finding: commercial_monitor.check_checkout_readiness() derived 'Gumroad status' purely from a local snapshot (data/asset_registry.json) and then emitted a hard verdict from it: products=20, published=0, status='BLOCKED', blocking_note='All channels blocked - founder action required'.
REAL_BUG_FOUND_AND_FIXED_FALSE_BLOCKER.live_reality_at_the_same_moment: the live Gumroad API returned published=True for 10/10 products on page one, and 77 products were counted across pages in cycle 107, each of the three flagships verified published with a real delivery file attached
REAL_BUG_FOUND_AND_FIXED_FALSE_BLOCKER.root_cause: all 20 registry entries were still at production_status='PRODUCED' and the file was 21.6 days stale, so the `is_published` comparison was False BY CONSTRUCTION. It could not have been anything else regardless of what was actually live on Gumroad.
REAL_BUG_FOUND_AND_FIXED_FALSE_BLOCKER.why_this_is_the_worst_class_of_bug_here: it invents a blocker and points the founder at a channel that is working. That is the same failure mode as the cycle-105 evidence ledger, in the opposite direction - there a real signal was over-claimed, here a real channel was falsely condemned.
FIX_APPLIED: the gumroad block now declares evidence_source='LOCAL_SNAPSHOT_ONLY', registry_age_days, snapshot_is_stale, a caveat stating these counts describe what the factory recorded and not what Gumroad serves, and an explicit live_platform_state='UNKNOWN from this function - verify with GET /v2/products'

the blocking note may no longer say 'founder action required' on the grounds of a stale snapshot; it now states plainly that this is NOT evidence Gumroad is blocked and must be verified against the live API first
the snapshot counts themselves are still reported truthfully - only the authority to assert a blocker was removed
